Admissions Process
There are a limited number of seats available for each incoming cohort, making admissions into Rowan-Virtua TBES a competitive process. During the admissions process, we consider more than just your academic achievements; you are also evaluated on recommendations from your former professors, your personal statement, and other experiences you may have. This comprehensive process allows us to learn about you thoroughly and assess your ability to succeed at the graduate level.
Admissions are subject to the Rowan University Non-discrimination Policy.
Apply now
Academic Background
Application Requirements
International Applicants
A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university is required.
All applicants should have completed college courses in:
Biology, biochemistry, physics, general chemistry and organic chemistry.
It is highly recommended applicants have completed courses in:
Calculus, molecular biology and cell biology.
For the Histopathology program:
Required completed courses - cell biology and general chemistry.
Highly recommended courses - anatomy and physiology.
Useful courses - organic chemistry, microbiology, immunology and histology.
We cannot preview your credentials or indicate the likelihood of acceptance prior to receipt of the completed application.
An online application
Official transcripts of all undergraduate and graduate records
Students must have earned a Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited school.
Official test scores
PhD programs: submission of GRE is optional.
Master's & Certificate programs:
Biomedical Sciences and Histopathology programs - GRE general test, MCAT or DAT is not required, but strongly recommended.
Scores must be taken within five years of the semester in which the student will matriculate.
Prospective international students must show proof of English language proficiency as outlined by Rowan's International Center.
Letters of Recommendation
PhD programs require three recommendations.
Master's and Certificate programs require two recommendations.
Applicants are encouraged to request letters from academic instructors or supervisors/mentors with knowledge of their academic abilities, professionalism, independence, leadership, critical thinking, and/or ability to work well with others.
TBES collects all recommendation forms through your online application portal.
Personal statement
Applicants are required to submit a personal statement as part of their online application.
This statement should address the applicant’s motivation for joining their chosen graduate program and their goals in their chosen field of study.
Interview with Admissions Committee
Only required for the PhD and Histopathology applicants.
Not all applicants will be invited for an admissions interview.
Resume or CV
All applicants must submit a resume or CV in your application portal.
Where to send application materials
All application materials are collected within our Slate CRM platform. You can access the materials upload by logging into the application portal.
Please review additional information and requirements on our International Applicants page.
Application Deadlines
All application items must be received by the deadline indicated below for consideration. All deadlines are for Fall admissions unless otherwise indicated.
